reason: PR #485 exact head 29491b2e4f7050e9d5b37598af759e6d84d8dbcc exposed one base-owned stale bilingual-search CSS contract after the separately authorized WP-1 semantic-theme migration. Stage 6.4.5.9 run 32171607447 executes Product WP0 on the fresh trusted-main base and fails tests/wp0/v21-product-experience-bilingual-search-translation-task-ux.test.js because that historical contract still requires the private --yance-surface token for the bilingual search field. Trusted main e6d59699608a319edd04f628854978f4c07187eb still legitimately uses that pre-migration token, while the WP-1 candidate intentionally consumes the canonical semantic theme authority and uses --surface-control for the same field. Reintroducing --yance-surface in Product code would violate the approved semantic-theme migration. This authorization permits only a permanent dual-state semantic test contract: preserve the exact trusted-main assertion while the legacy palette is present, and require the canonical semantic surface contract once the source has migrated. Selection may depend only on source content, never branch name, environment, CI state or skip flags. No Product code, workflow, route, scanner, dependency or authority change is authorized.
